name: hello-ios-example
description: Cross-device iOS demo: native ↔ webview parity via BrokerCore (tish-desktop) + tish:ios host (tish-apple)

scripts.build: tish build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios-sim --platform ios --surface native src/main.tish -o dist/hello-ios
scripts.build:device: tish build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios --platform ios --surface native src/main.tish -o dist/hello-ios
